
{{alias}}( order, uplo, way, N, A, LDA, E, IPIV )
    Converts or reverts symmetric indefinite rook-factor storage in place.

    IPIV is read-only, signed, and 1-based, exactly as supplied by LAPACK.
    Adjacent negative values describe a 2x2 block and can differ. The value -1
    retains the first-row target and the negative block marker.

    Conversion extracts the off-diagonal entries of the 2x2 diagonal blocks
    into E, zeros their stored matrix entries, and applies row permutations.
    Reversion undoes the permutations and restores those entries from E.
    Reversion leaves E unchanged. The diagonal, opposite triangle, padding,
    and IPIV remain unchanged in both directions.

    The full N-by-N matrix view and N-element E/IPIV indexed-byte envelopes
    must be pairwise disjoint, even if interleaved active slots differ.
    Disjoint typed-array views in one ordinary ArrayBuffer are permitted.

    For N>0, all actual typed-array backing stores must be ordinary
    ArrayBuffer objects. SharedArrayBuffer-backed views are rejected with
    a TypeError before routine-owned writes, including shared buffers
    returned by structuredClone. A shadowed .buffer property does not
    change this rule.
    Exotic ArrayBuffers with storage externally aliased by foreign native
    addons are outside the caller contract.

    After scalar validation, N=0 returns 0 without accessing buffers. LDA
    must still be at least 1. Invalid scalar selectors or dimensions fail
    even for an empty matrix.

    Parameters
    ----------
    order: string
        Must be 'row-major' or 'column-major'.

    uplo: string
        Stored triangle. Must be 'upper' or 'lower'.

    way: string
        Conversion direction. Must be 'convert' or 'revert'.

    N: integer
        Matrix order. Nonnegative safe integer not exceeding 2147483647.

    A: Float64Array
        Input/output factor storage. The full leading N-by-N view must fit.

    LDA: integer
        Leading dimension. Must be at least max(1,N).

    E: Float64Array
        N off-diagonal block values. Output for conversion; input for
        reversion.

    IPIV: Int32Array
        N unchanged signed 1-based LAPACK rook pivot values.

    Returns
    -------
    info: number
        Zero on success.

    Examples
    --------
    > var A = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0, 2, 999, 0 ] );
    > var E = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( 2 );
    > var IPIV = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/int32}}( [ -1, -2 ] );
    > {{alias}}( 'row-major', 'upper', 'convert', 2, A, 2, E, IPIV )
    0
    > E
    <Float64Array>[ 0.0, 2.0 ]
    > {{alias}}( 'row-major', 'upper', 'revert', 2, A, 2, E, IPIV )
    0
    > A
    <Float64Array>[ 0.0, 2.0, 999.0, 0.0 ]


{{alias}}.ndarray( uplo, way, N, A, sa1, sa2, oa, E, se, oe, IPIV, sp, op )
    Converts or reverts rook-factor storage using alternative indexing
    semantics.

    All strides and offsets are element indices relative to each typed-array
    view. Positive and negative independent strides are supported. The full
    matrix view must be injective. For N>1, E cannot have zero stride.
    Read-only IPIV may have zero stride if its repeated pivot sequence is
    structurally valid. All active index arithmetic must use exact safe
    integers, and all views must fit their buffers.

    This interface has the same pivot, buffer, aliasing, mutation, and
    zero-order rules as the standard interface. Unused strides and offsets
    are not accessed when N=0.

    Parameters
    ----------
    uplo: string
        Stored triangle. Must be 'upper' or 'lower'.

    way: string
        Conversion direction. Must be 'convert' or 'revert'.

    N: integer
        Matrix order.

    A: Float64Array
        Input/output factor storage.

    sa1: integer
        Matrix row stride.

    sa2: integer
        Matrix column stride.

    oa: integer
        Starting index for A.

    E: Float64Array
        Off-diagonal block values.

    se: integer
        E stride.

    oe: integer
        Starting index for E.

    IPIV: Int32Array
        Read-only signed 1-based LAPACK rook pivots.

    sp: integer
        IPIV stride.

    op: integer
        Starting index for IPIV.

    Returns
    -------
    info: number
        Zero on success.

    Examples
    --------
    > var A = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0, 2, 999, 0 ] );
    > var E = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 8.0, 0.0, 0.0, 8.0 ] );
    > var P = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/int32}}( [ 9, -1, -2, 9 ] );
    > {{alias}}.ndarray( 'upper', 'convert', 2, A, 2, 1, 0, E, 1, 1, P, 1, 1 )
    0
    > E
    <Float64Array>[ 8.0, 0.0, 2.0, 8.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
